mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases by >0.3pp over the last 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the correlation between UNRATE increase and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in the federal funds rate and rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) reduces real interest rates, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL does not produce positive returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve's tightening response suppresses equity returns, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of high-inflation periods, or the average return in high-inflation regimes is not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening consumer demand and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 (index, 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the correlation between INDPRO decline and negative returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market conditions, defined by rising employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE), signal robust economic growth and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with joint PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline, or the interaction term's coefficient is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (GDPC1 quarterly growth rate < 1.5% annualized), economic slowdown risks trigger negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods, or the average return in these regimes is not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
